review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Overview We are seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our IT infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, and manage IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and cloud environments. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure stability and security. Implement and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. Document configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. Required Skills & Qual
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have expertise in networking, cloud computing, server management, and security, ensuring high availability and optimal performance of our systems. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. years of experience in infrastructure management, system administration, or a similar role. Proficiency in automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or PowerShell. Preferred Qualifications Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, CCNA, or RHCE.
